name: Juke Songo
desc: FUSES footwork's triplet kick grid (drums.footwork.triplet_grid) with Cuban songo/clave timekeeping (drums.latin.songo): 808 kicks stagger juke-style while clave and bongo answer in son phrasing - Chicago meets Havana at speed.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(${heat}).gain(${gain}*.8), s("~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ ~").gain(${hand}*.8)).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").shape(${heat}).gain(${gain}), s("[~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ ~, bongo(3,8,1)]").speed(1.1).gain(${hand}).shape(.3), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(.25,.5).fast(4))).lpf(9000).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd bd ~ bd ~ bd ~ bd]>").bank("RolandTR808").shape(${heat}*1.2).gain(${gain}), s("[~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ clave, bongo(5,16,2), conga(3,8)]").speed("<1.1 1.2>").gain(${hand}).shape(.35), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 2>").gain(saw.range(.3,.55).fast(4))).lpf(11000).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
